10.text: And the same on step four: its fifth choice, who writes what Show me more opens, was built before you answered. That is question six: A, the agent, as built; B, the tool, from the lines; C, no diagram.

11.text: What ran: the fast suite, two new specs, the microphone end to end, a code check. Not done: live words in a real browser, a hosted round page, a round before a real plan.

12.text: That's find the gaps, running. Seeing it run, anything you'd change?

01.text: A plan could rest on a wrong picture of the code. Now you first answer a few cards; each turns over to the code's lines, and you settle each gap. A fresh checker, a new agent with only those lines, must read each predict card as it does, or the check stops: the agent rewrites the card once, or drops it.

02.text: Quick check. The fresh checker reads card c2's lines as A. The card says B. What does the check do?

03.text: A quote one word off is stopped. The checker reads c2 as A: stopped, rewrite it once. It reads B: it passes. My choices, each a card at the right: the checker's question mark stops a card too. No checker answer, no round. One range of lines a card. A round finds its repo from its own folder.

04.text: On the review page: no session waiting, a command set, where does it go? Pick A, the inbox; it turns over to B, a headless run, with its line: a gap. A point card: click a box of its diagram. What you skip is listed in the plan as assumed, not checked. My choices: each answer is routed once. The page has its own address. A round's Send never starts a headless run. A settled card moves on.

05.text: On a say card, hold Space and talk: whisper writes it down here, or, with the switch on, your browser shows live words. A fresh checker reads the session's marks before you do: a match, a gap, or a want. My choices: your words reach the session as a question. Speech stays on this machine. The recording is thrown away once written down.

06.text: Quick check. You settle c2 with Got it, and skip c3. Where does c3 go?

07.text: Record it: c1, called right, into the plan's You told me first; c2, Got it, into your memory; c3, skipped, assumed, not checked. My choices: what you know is a marked line in your memory file. A due thing comes back as a new card. You told me first sits before the steps. Show me more's video is one explainer. The agent draws a card's diagram. A later video is warned where it shows what you know.

08.text: A wrong quick check in any video settles the same way, and Change the plan's box takes your words. Reel status counts rounds. My choices: a header line records a round, question five. A late fix counts once. The buttons sit in the check's box. Got it sends no rewrite. Show me more with no example asks again.

09.text: One thing went off the plan: a step's fifth choice should stop and ask. Step five went on, and asked after: where is it kept whether a round ran? A, a header line, as built; B, a command; C, the rounds alone.
